description.narrative: Heavy rain and floods in CAR since September and more intensely since October. In September a DREF was issued targeting 3000 HH. CAR government has declared a state of emergency. Latest figures are 97 000 people displaced (OCHA). Figures seems to be increasing. Areas bordering the Ubangi river are most affected including the city of Bangui which accounts for half of the affected people. In mid-November a second DREF was issued and the EA. The EA requests 3 million CHF for 18 months focussing on emergency relief early recovery and more long-term programming. Targeting 12 out of 16 locations affected (4 remaining covered by ICRC in conflict settings). Main focus of EA is on shelter both emergency and long-term primarily in Bangui. Other components are livelihoods and basic needs (emergency and long-term) health (first aid community awareness epidemic surveillance etc) and WASH. Mainstream protection inclusion CEA DRR. EPoA has not yet been shared but will hopefully be published during this week.
